nodes.label: Subterranean Agent (Compiled Model)
nodes.rationale: A fine-tuned 3B/8B LLM that internalizes procedural knowledge through training on synthetic conversations, eliminating routing failures and template constraints of orchestrated systems.

nodes.label: LangGraph Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: A modular agent framework using Claude Sonnet 4.5 that routes between decision hubs via API calls, incurring latency and routing failure modes.

nodes.label: In-Context Baseline
nodes.rationale: Frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4.5) with full procedure serialized in system prompt on every turn; establishes quality ceiling.

nodes.label: Compilation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Three-stage process: (1) synthetic data generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5 traversing flowchart, (2) fine-tuning with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, (3) evaluation via vLLM batching.

nodes.label: Cost Reduction Analysis
nodes.rationale: Compounds per-token cost reduction (65× via self-hosting on A100) with token volume reduction (2-7× depending on procedure complexity).

nodes.label: Failure Mode Analysis
nodes.rationale: Compiled model eliminates routing failures by construction; orchestrator shows 24% failure rate on travel vs 5.5% for compiled model.

nodes.label: One-Question-Per-Turn Conversational Style
nodes.rationale: Learned from training data; 64% of turns contain exactly one question, producing clearer audit trails and potentially reducing user cognitive load.

nodes.label: Dennis et al. 2026a - Orchestration Failure Modes
nodes.rationale: Identifies three structural costs of orchestration: fragmented reasoning, routing failures, template-constrained responses.

nodes.label: Subterranean Agent Architecture
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Compilation of agentic workflows into LLM weights; procedure internalized during training, no runtime orchestration needed

nodes.label: Surface Orchestration Architecture
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: External orchestrator injects instructions and parses outputs every turn; contrasted with subterranean approach

nodes.label: Travel Booking Workflow (14 nodes, 3 decision hubs)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Test domain for compilation; 86 unique acyclic paths, 4-17 turns; controlled same-model comparison baseline

nodes.label: Zoom Support Workflow (14 nodes, parallel structure)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Product-specific domain encoding troubleshooting knowledge; 60 unique paths; tests domain knowledge internalization

nodes.label: Insurance Claims Workflow (55 nodes, 6 decision hubs)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Complex workflow with nested loops and cross-phase dependencies; 2,381 unique paths; tests compilation scalability

nodes.label: LangGraph Orchestrator Baseline
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Frontier model baseline using Claude Sonnet 4.5; ~70× more parameters than 3B compiled model; most widely adopted agent framework

nodes.label: In-Context Baseline (Frontier Model with Serialized Flowchart)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Upper bound for frontier model quality; Claude Sonnet 4.5 with full flowchart in system prompt; establishes quality ceiling

nodes.label: Qwen 2.5 3B Instruct
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Base model for travel booking compilation; fine-tuned on 2,125 synthetic conversations; demonstrates compilation benefits vs orchestration

nodes.label: LLM-as-Judge Evaluation Methodology
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Approach-agnostic evaluation using Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-4.1 judges; 5 criteria (Task Success, Info Accuracy, Consistency, Graceful Handling, Naturalness) on 1-5 scale

nodes.label: Dynamic User Simulation
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Claude Sonnet 4.5 generates contextually appropriate user responses; no knowledge of flowchart; ensures realistic conversation divergence

nodes.label: Full Parameter Fine-Tuning Strategy
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Parameter-efficient methods (LoRA) fail on procedural tasks; full updates required for implicit state-tracking behavior modification

nodes.label: Quality Gap: 87-98% of Frontier
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: 8B compiled model achieves 87-98% of in-context frontier quality; 3B model lags on graceful handling and naturalness (~82%)

nodes.label: Cost Reduction: 128-462× Cheaper
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Compiled models 128-462× cheaper per conversation; combines ~65× per-token reduction from self-hosting with 2-7× token volume reduction

nodes.label: Recompile Cycle: 30-50 Minutes
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Procedure changes require 30-50 minute recompile on production hardware; CI/CD cycle, not prohibitive retraining

nodes.label: Failure Rate: Compiled vs Orchestrator
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Compiled models show lower failure rates: travel 5.5% vs 24%, insurance 9% vs 17%; comparable on Zoom

nodes.label: Latency Improvement: 2.8× Faster
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Local inference reduces latency by 2.8× in insurance domain

nodes.label: Agent Orchestration Frameworks (290K GitHub Stars)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Strands, LlamaIndex; all follow external orchestrator pattern

nodes.label: Prior Compilation Work (SimpleTOD, FireAct, SynTOD, WorkflowLLM, Agent Lumos)
nodes.author: Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo
nodes.rationale: Established compilation techniques with ~3,000 stars combined; 100× less adoption than orchestration frameworks
